title: Azure role assignments
summary: Azure role-based access control assigns a role to an identity at a scope. Scope can be a resource, resource group or broader boundary.
introduction: Azure role-based access control assigns a role to an identity at a scope. Scope can be a resource, resource group or broader boundary. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
